rationale.consistency: Idiomatically structures the commands and cleanly mirrors the conventions and flags of existing zoekt tools.
rationale.edge_cases: Gracefully handles unreadable directories, path collisions, empty indices, wildcard branches, and concurrent executions.
rationale.scope: Strictly delivers the requested subcommands, preview/force modes, and name preservation without unrelated refactoring.
rationale.readability: Logic is well-compartmentalized across files, with clear variable names and intuitive command routing.
rationale.robustness: Prevents data races with a robust file lock, enforces read-only dry runs, and includes a precise up-to-date check to avoid redundant operations.
rationale.maintainability: Extends existing gitindex configurations cleanly, preserving backward compatibility while making the new capabilities easy to iterate on.
